notes: Panel after Mothershed et al. 2004 (J Clin Microbiol 42:320-328) as implemented by meningotype
EX7E probe trick: the synG EX7E motif peptide at residue 3 reads P in serogroup W, G in Y, S in dual W/Y (meningotype menwy); a 99.5 identity floor means only the exact allele probe counts
The probe record stands alone (no full-length synG in the db): abricate's -culling_limit 1 would otherwise shadow the contained probe alignment
EX7E probe trick (see serogroup W): a dual W/Y strain (EX7E = S) clears neither allele probe and falls back to NG — allele-level ambiguity needs a future allele_match primitive
